item_text: Fixed fee of INR 85,000 with 40% on signing and 60% on delivery.
source_quote: **Fee:** INR 85,000, fixed. 40% on signing, 60% on delivery.

item_text: Build a five-page static marketing website consisting of Home, Collections, About, Contact, and Store Locator pages.
source_quote: The contractor will build a five-page static marketing website consisting of Home, Collections, About, Contact, and Store Locator pages.

item_text: Responsive website rendering on current mobile and desktop browsers.
source_quote: The site will be responsive and render correctly on current mobile and desktop browsers.

item_text: Contact form on Contact page delivering submissions by email.
source_quote: A contact form will be included on the Contact page, delivering submissions by email to the store's registered address.

item_text: Basic on-page SEO including page titles, meta descriptions, and XML sitemap.
source_quote: Basic on-page search engine optimisation is included: page titles, meta descriptions, and an XML sitemap.

item_text: Deployment of finished site to client's existing hosting account.
source_quote: The contractor will deploy the finished site to the client's existing hosting account.

item_text: One round of revisions included following site delivery.
source_quote: One round of revisions is included following delivery of the completed site.

item_text: Revisions must be requested within 14 days of delivery.
source_quote: Revisions must be requested within fourteen days of delivery.

item_text: Exclusion of online payments, shopping cart, and e-commerce functionality.
source_quote: Online payments, shopping cart, and any e-commerce functionality are excluded from this agreement.

item_text: Exclusion of content translation and multi-language versions.
source_quote: Content translation and multi-language versions of the site are excluded.

item_text: Exclusion of ongoing maintenance, hosting fees, and photography.
source_quote: Ongoing maintenance, hosting fees, and photography are excluded.

item_text: Delivery within four weeks of signing.
source_quote: Delivery within four weeks of signing.

item_text: Timeline extensions caused by late client content delivery.
source_quote: Delays caused by late delivery of client content extend the timeline accordingly.

item_text: Requirement of written change order and separate fee agreement for unlisted work.
source_quote: Any work not described in Section 1 requires a written change order and separate fee agreement before the contractor begins that work.
